class A {
  private static x = 1;
}
class B extends A {
  static x = 2;
}
class C {
  static y = 1;
}
class D extends C {
  protected static y = 2;
}
class E {
  private static z = 1;
}
class F extends E {
  private static z = 2;
}
class G {
  protected static w = 1;
}
class H extends G {
  static w = 2;
}
class I extends G {
  protected static w = 3;
}
console.log(B.x, new D(), new F(), H.w, new I());
